idea-plugin.description:
Formats C# files with DressSharp, the unopinionated formatter that applies only the rules you set in EditorConfig.

A file is formatted when the repository installs DressSharp as a local .NET tool, in a .config/dotnet-tools.json above the file, and an .editorconfig applies to it. Other files are left alone, so the plugin is safe to leave enabled across every solution.

  • Format on save, switched on and off from Settings | Tools | Actions on Save.
  • Code | Format with DressSharp for the current file or the files selected in the Solution Explorer.
idea-plugin.name: DressSharp

action.description: Format the selected C# files with DressSharp, the formatter that applies only the EditorConfig rules you set
